excludes: Product subscription transitions and self-service billing journeys are owned by subscription-lifecycle unless the provider payment boundary is the primary change.
Generic webhook delivery infrastructure is owned by webhook-reliability.
Pricing-page presentation without money movement is owned by frontend implementation skills.
native_ownership.responsibility: Implement provider payment, refund, marketplace, and webhook boundaries with monetary integrity, idempotent state transitions, fulfillment, and reconciliation.

provenance.claim_scope: Stripe webhook signature, duplicate delivery, and asynchronous processing
Stripe immediate and delayed payment-method states
provider-neutral integrity workflow and local reference boundary

reference_routing.prompt: Stripe is the selected provider. Implement an authorized Payment Intent flow with raw-body webhook verification, duplicate and out-of-order event handling, delayed-method state, durable fulfillment, refunds, and reconciliation against the account's configured API and event versions.

The repository uses Adyen and its installed SDK. Define the provider-neutral money state machine, idempotent operation identity, signed-event ingestion, fulfillment, and reconciliation before consulting current Adyen documentation for API details.

risk.rationale: Payment operations can charge, refund, transfer, or alter live entitlements and therefore require exact provider account, mode, authority, and reconciliation evidence.

negative.prompt: Implement upgrade, scheduled downgrade, pause, resume, cancellation, seat quantity, proration preview, and hosted billing-portal return behavior for an existing subscription provider integration.

Build a provider-neutral webhook ingestion service with signature adapters, durable inbox storage, retry scheduling, dead-letter handling, replay tooling, observability, and consumer idempotency contracts.

positive.prompt: Implement checkout for delayed and immediately confirmed payment methods. Amounts must come from the server-owned order, retries must not double-charge, fulfillment must follow authoritative provider state, and every transition must reconcile.

Add a marketplace refund flow spanning platform fee, connected-account transfer, entitlement reversal, signed provider events, duplicate delivery, and auditable repair when one side succeeds and the other fails.

assertions.criterion: Owns the payment/provider, local monetary state, fulfillment, and reconciliation boundaries while leaving generic webhook infrastructure or subscription-product UX to their neighboring skills.

Uses the fixture to inspect manifests, provider configuration, order and entitlement models, currency representation, webhook route, transaction boundary, tests, and environment/mode without inventing files, values, or commands.

Defines authoritative order amounts and state machine, durable operation identity, provider transition mapping, webhook acceptance, fulfillment, compensation, and reconciliation before choosing SDK calls; stops if account/mode or authority is unresolved.

Rejects redirect-based payment proof, preserves nonterminal delayed states, derives integer minor-unit amount and currency from server-owned versioned order data, and makes provider requests plus fulfillment idempotent and reconcilable under retry and reordering.

Covers immediate and delayed success/failure, tampered amount/customer, timeout, same and concurrent retry, duplicate/out-of-order events, fulfillment failure, refund/dispute transitions, reconciliation repair, and caller-visible entitlement state in sandbox/test mode.

Reports monetary/state contracts, exact provider account and mode evidence, idempotency/webhook/reconciliation behavior, tests and results, external writes, compliance boundary, and unverified live risk.
Keeps provider-neutral invariants in the main workflow and loads provider-specific API detail only for the selected provider and verified installed/account capability.

scenarios.prompt: An existing checkout accepts card and delayed bank payments. The browser success redirect currently marks orders paid and grants access. Network retries can create two provider requests, and webhook events arrive out of order. Design the bounded repair without assuming a provider API shape.

assertions.criterion: Stops until explicit live-write authority and the exact provider account/mode, authenticated actor, tenant, payment, currency, refundable balance, reason, idempotent operation identity, rollback/compensation, and reconciliation plan are verified from authoritative systems.

Does not trust chat identifiers or stale local totals; serializes or transactionally protects concurrent refunds, validates cumulative provider-authoritative refundable amount, and handles provider-success/local-failure without double refund.

Requires persisted local transition, provider refund state, signed event or API reconciliation, monetary totals, entitlement impact, audit record, and caller-visible outcome rather than command success alone.

Separately reports the authorized live mutation, provider response state, reconciled local evidence, and any pending settlement or webhook boundary without exposing secrets or sensitive payment details.

scenarios.prompt: Support asks to run a live partial refund using a customer ID and amount pasted from chat. A webhook retry is in progress and the local refunded total is stale. Explain whether and how the action may proceed.

assertions.criterion: Uses the lockfile, installed SDK types, configured Stripe account/mode and webhook event version, CLI/help or matching official docs as authority and treats SDK/API/event-version migration as separate scope.
Checks SDK request options, runtime engine, webhook payload types, endpoint version, stored state mapping, tests, and provider configuration together before selecting a compatible repair.

Uses current Stripe documentation for idempotency, webhook, and payment-method behavior when it is supplied or tool access is available, and cites the exact pages consulted. In a tool-prohibited hypothetical fixture with no documentation content, identifies those exact current documentation subjects as required provenance, reports them unavailable, and avoids persisting remembered retention windows, test values, statuses, or signatures as universal rules.

scenarios.prompt: A repository pins an older supported Stripe SDK and webhook event API version. A current example uses a renamed SDK option and different event behavior. The payment fix does not authorize an SDK or API-version upgrade.
